purpose: Review official Iraqi cadastral/land-registration channels and assess bounded anonymous parcel evidence for Ramadi.
assessment: Official Iraqi sources establish real-estate registration custody in Anbar/Ramadi and a national geographic portal, but the bounded anonymous routes inspected exposed only service descriptions and institutional/state-land layers. No parcel ID+geometry response was obtained, so no GeoJSON sample is retained.
